missing_catalogue_rows.description: A rational approximation of a real number within a positive rational tolerance: for $x \in \mathbb{R}$ and $\varepsilon \in \mathbb{Q}_{>0}$, a chosen $a \in \mathbb{Q}$ with $|x - a| < \varepsilon$ (a choice-bearing operation; the chosen decimal is retained with the exact source and both tolerances).

The factorization of a nonzero element of a unique factorization domain into a unit and irreducible factors with multiplicities, for $\mathbb{Z}$ (the catalogue has it for $\mathbb{N}^{+}$ through `mor.sets.nat_prime_factors` and `mor.sets.nat_multiplicity`, and for $R[x]$ through `mor.sets.polynomial_factorization`).

Primality of an element of a commutative ring ($x$ prime when $(x)$ is a nonzero prime ideal), for $\mathbb{Z}$, so that $-7$ is prime and $0$, $1$ are not (the catalogue has `mor.sets.nat_is_prime` on $\mathbb{N}$ only).
A chosen square root in $\mathbb{C}$ of a negative rational, $\sqrt{-4} = 2i$ (the catalogue has `mor.sets.real_sqrt` on $\mathbb{R}$ only).

Exponentiation of cardinals, $2^{\kappa}$ (Mathlib `Cardinal.power`), so that $|\mathcal{P}(A)| = 2^{|A|}$ can be stated (the catalogue has the cardinal literals `lit.cardinals` and no operation on `cat.cardinals`).

The enumeration $\mathbb{N} \to X$ of a denumerable set in the adopted `Denumerable.ofNat` order ($\mathbb{Z}$: $0, -1, 1, -2, 2, \ldots$; $\mathbb{Q}$: $0, -1, -1/2, 1, 1/2, \ldots$) and its evaluation $X[k]$; objects of `cat.enumerated_sets` for $\mathbb{N}$, $\mathbb{Z}$, $\mathbb{Q}$ and the progressions (the category and its classifier exist; no object or morphism row does).

The multiset of roots of a nonzero polynomial over a domain, with multiplicity (Mathlib `Polynomial.roots`); `mor.sets.polynomial_roots` gives the finite root set $R[x] \setminus \{0\} \to \mathcal{P}_{\mathrm{fin}}(R)$.
The derivation $d/dx : \mathbb{Q}[x] \to \mathbb{Q}[x]$ as a morphism of $\mathbb{Q}$-modules, so that its kernel is a subobject (`mor.sets.polynomial_derivative` is a map of sets).
The truncation $R[[t]] \to R[[t]]/(t^{n})$ (the quotient by $(t^{n})$, an $R$-algebra map) with its display $\sum_{k<n} a_k t^k + O(t^{n})$.

A linear map $\mathbb{Q}^{n} \to \mathbb{Q}^{m}$ given by a formula $(x_1, \ldots, x_n) \mapsto (\ldots)$ linear in its binders, as a morphism of `cat.modules_r` with its kernel and image (`mor.modules.row_linear_map` and `mor.modules.matrix_linear_map` take a matrix).
Objects of `cat.ideals_r` (the principal ideal $(4) \subseteq \mathbb{Z}$) so that `meth.annihilator` has a value to compare with; `cat.ideals_r` has no object row.
The ℤ-module $\mathbb{Z}/4$ as an object of `cat.modules_r` (written `ℤ/4 in Modules(ℤ)`); the module rows are `obj.modules.regular`, `obj.modules.vectors` and the restricted regular module.
The inclusion $\mathbb{Q}[[t]] \subseteq \mathbb{R}[[t]]$ induced by $\mathbb{Q} \subseteq \mathbb{R}$ (the catalogue inclusions are those of the number systems).
The real function $\arctan$ (the catalogue functions are `mor.sets.real_sin`, `real_cos`, `real_exp`, `real_sqrt`, `real_pi`).
The gcd of two polynomials over a UFD (`mor.sets.gcd` is the gcd of integers).
Irreducibility of a nonzero polynomial over a domain (a prime element of $R[x]$).
The cardinal $2^{\aleph_0}$ of $\mathbb{R}$ (no statement of the workloads needs an uncountable cardinal; the plan records it).
Membership in the unit group $\mathrm{Mat}_n(K)^{\times}$ as a decided predicate (the workloads read $M$ in $\mathrm{Mat}_2(\mathbb{Q})^{\times}$ as an ascription).
